What still blocks THIS clause is two things local to this file, neither of them a SaftyFW gap: (1) it schedules no operator actions, so K4 never closes here and sim_engine.c gates duty/current to zero (measured any_current_present true on 0 of 82 polls); (2) independently, its own `at_zone_temp 400C` trigger is unreachable in this run's time budget even with K4 closed -- the fast_test preset asymptotes at ~505C with a ~200s time constant, so 400C needs ~304 sim-seconds of full duty, against an estimated run duration of ~195s. The fault never fires, which is why the clause reports 'triggering event never occurred'.]
